decisions.state_note: o000: Window around x105–168,y59–122 shows a thick dark bend from the left into a descending near-vertical band near x132; stroke continues below crop. Digit unresolved.
o001: Window x105–168,y91–154 shows a thick near-vertical dark stroke around x131–139, continuing through the bottom crop; detector also reports upright band. No endpoint visible.

o002: Window x105–168,y123–186 shows a thick slightly right-leaning upright stroke, continuing through both vertical crop edges; detector reports upright band near (139,154). Lower termination remains unseen.

o003: Window x105–168,y155–218 shows a thick dark stroke leaning right as it descends, reaching the lower and right crop edges. Detector supports an upright segment near (143,173); no terminal cap is visible.

o004: Window x105–168,y123–186 again shows a thick slightly right-leaning upright stroke crossing the top and bottom crop boundaries; detector agrees. Upper structure and lower termination remain unresolved.
o005: Window x105–168,y91–154 shows a thick upright stroke near x130–140, slightly bending right lower down and cropped at top and bottom. Detector agrees; upper structure remains unresolved.
o006: At x105–168,y59–122, dark upper arm enters from left and bends downward near x128; below-left light recess visible. Detector reports elbow and upright segment. Left extent remains unseen.

o007: Window x73–136,y59–122 shows a broad horizontal dark band entering from the left and bending down at the right; white lies above and below the arm. Detector supports the horizontal band. Left extent remains cropped.

o008: Window x41–104,y59–122 shows a broad horizontal dark band around y63–99, with white below and a small white margin above; detector agrees. Its left side meets the crop, so no left endpoint is established.

o009: Window x41–104,y91–154 shows a dark strip along its top edge ending around y101, with white below. No detector instances; upper extent is cropped. Left end of the previously seen horizontal arm remains unresolved.

o010: Window x9–72,y91–154 shows a small dark fragment at the top near x46–72, with an uneven lower edge near y100 and white below. No detector instances; upper extent is cropped and no endpoint is established.

o011: Window x9–72,y59–122 shows a rounded left end of the upper dark arm near x38,y76, with white above, left, and below; arm continues beyond the right crop. No detector instances. Digit remains unresolved.

o012: Window x41–104,y59–122 shows the broad upper horizontal dark arm, with white margins above and below; detector agrees. Prior rightward bend and descending shaft remain the main structure; lower termination is unknown.

o013: Window x73–136,y59–122 shows a broad horizontal upper arm turning downward near x125, with a white recess below-left. Detector reports the horizontal band. Lower shaft termination remains unseen; 7 is a hypothesis.
o014: Upper dark arm turns downward around x128,y76, with a light recess below-left and upright shaft near x132,y109; detector agrees. Lower termination remains unseen.
o015: At x105–168,y91–154, a thick upright dark shaft bends slightly right toward the bottom crop; detector agrees. Both vertical ends are cropped. Lower termination remains unresolved.
o016: Window x105–168,y123–186 shows a thick upright shaft leaning slightly right, cropped at top and bottom; detector agrees. Lower termination remains unknown.

o017: At x105–168,y155–218, dark shaft slopes right downward and meets the right and bottom crop edges; detector supports upright segment near (143,173). No lower cap is visible; rightward continuation needs inspection.

o018: Window x137–200,y155–218 shows the descending shaft bending right near y196 and continuing through the bottom edge around x157–168. White is visible to its right; no cap or detector instance is visible.

o019: Bottom-clamped window x137–200,y160–223 shows the dark shaft bending right near y196 and reaching the canvas bottom around x157–168. No closing cap or light below it is visible; detector reports no instances.

o020: Window x105–168,y160–223 shows a thick shaft leaning right downward and continuing to the canvas bottom; detector supports an upright segment near (144,176). Upper area above the horizontal arm remains unobserved.
o021: Window x105–168,y128–191 shows a thick dark shaft leaning right downward, cropped at top and bottom; detector agrees. Area above the upper horizontal arm remains unobserved.
o022: Window x105–168,y96–159 shows a thick near-vertical dark shaft around x132–142, cropped at top and bottom; detector agrees. Area above the upper arm remains unresolved.
o023: Window x105–168,y64–127 shows a dark arm entering from left and bending into an upright shaft near x132; detector supports the shaft. Outer upper contour is cropped; area above remains unknown.

o024: Window x105–168,y32–95 shows white above a dark upper bend beginning near y62; no detector instances. Prior observations show a long horizontal top arm with rounded left end and a descending shaft. This supports digit 7, though the shaft unusually leans right.
